question: How is the figure seated on a lunar seat to be visualized in relation to the moon above?
premises: The practitioner meditates on the figure.
The figure is seated on a moon-seat.
The figure is struck or touched by the moon above.
inference: The visualization involves a figure seated on a lunar seat in contact with the moon above.
plain_english: Having meditated on him seated on a moon-seat and touched by the moon above.
